source.sourceName: Donghaeng Lottery official public draw-result API
source.sourceMethod: GET; srchDir=center&srchLtEpsd=latest followed by srchDir=older&srchCursorLtEpsd=oldest. Endpoint and parameter names read from official result-page JavaScript.

specification.selectionRule: Highest development mean exact full-six joint log-gain, including uniform; ties follow listed model order.
specification.singleAggregation: Arithmetic mean of p/(6/45) over the six current-source antecedents and all included lags.
specification.pairAggregation: Arithmetic mean of p/(6/45) over current-source pairs with training support >= 8 across lags 1,2,3; uniform fallback if no pairs qualify.
specification.similarity: At each lag L, historical source similarity is C(overlap with current source, 2)/15; use weighted target counts and weighted support with prior strength 80, then mean the three lag ratios.
specification.trainingConstraint: For prediction index t and lag L, current source is t-L; every historical source s has s+L<t.
specification.distribution: P(S)=product_{n in S}(w_n)/ESP6(w), unordered six-element sets.
specification.secondaryMetric: Mean of 45 exact-marginal squared errors; lower is better. Top-six match histogram, weights descending and number ascending for ties.
limitations: Final 104 historical draws were inspected in prior experiments; this is exploratory reuse, not a fresh holdout.
99.1667% intervals for six alternatives are only an approximate Bonferroni family-wise adjustment; block bootstrap coverage and post-selection effects remain approximate.
No hyperparameter tuning or model redefinition after scores are viewed.
specification.mixture: Exact equal mixture of normalized unordered-ticket distributions of uniform and the five temporal models. P_mix(S)=sum(P_component(S))/6. Marginals are means of component marginals. Joint score uses logsumexp of component log-probabilities, never averaged weights.

reusedHistoricalTest.interpretation: Exploratory historical reuse; previously inspected in earlier experiments.

primaryMetric.name: exact unordered-six joint log-score gain versus uniform

inference.bootstrap: circular blocks of length 4, 4000 percentile replicates; paired indices across models
inference.intervalInterpretation: Exploratory approximate intervals; neither fresh confirmation nor guaranteed coverage. Selected 95% interval does not adjust for model selection.

limitations: The last 104 draws are reused historical observations, not a fresh untouched holdout.
Model definitions and the exact-mixture addition were fixed before any scores in this experiment were computed or viewed.
Six candidate alternatives use approximate Bonferroni intervals; bootstrap coverage remains approximate.
The selected-model 95% interval is unadjusted for selection and historical reuse.
A favorable historical score cannot establish extreme or guaranteed future lottery winning probabilities.
Top-six match counts describe deterministic ranked numbers, not performance of five purchased tickets.
Product-weight probabilities are modeling assumptions; lottery outcome probabilities remain uniform under a fair independent draw.
